description.en: The ID of the file system.
The ID of the lifecycle policy.

title.zh: 停止执行生命周期策略

descriptions.zh:
停止执行生命周期策略。
仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统的生命周期管理策略中 LifecyclePolicyType 为 OnDemand 时支持。
descriptions.en: This operation applies only when the LifecyclePolicyType parameter of a lifecycle management policy for a CPFS file system is set to OnDemand.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas stop-lifecycle-policy-execution --file-system-id bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya0000 --lifecycle-policy-id lc-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
